name: Cape Canaveral SLC-40
best_known_for: Highest-cadence Falcon 9 pad on the planet — workhorse for ISS resupply + Starlink + national-security
credit: Operational pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. Originally Titan III / Titan IV (1965-2005); SpaceX leased and refit 2008; supports Falcon 9 commercial + national-security + Crew Dragon launches at the highest cadence of any orbital pad. AMOS-6 explosion 2016 forced a rebuild + capability upgrade. Coordinates from public FAA + USSF records.
